description: Invoice money as text (decision #69). Every case names its function in input.function. formatMoney: the currency's prefix, then cents / 100 with exactly two decimals and a dot, no grouping, never locale-formatted. The prefix is the symbol for the five known codes (USD, CAD, AUD and NZD "$", GBP "£") and, for any other code, the code itself and one space; codes are compared exactly as stored, in upper case. A currency that is left out or null is USD. A negative amount puts the minus sign first, before the symbol or the code, and then reads as the positive amount does ("-$70.00", "-£62.50", "-CHF 70.00"); zero is never signed. formatMoneyShort: the same, except an amount that is a whole number of units has no decimals ("$70", "-$70"). buildInvoiceText: the plain text a coach shares: "Invoice — {athleteName}" (an em dash), the period as "{start} – {end}" (an en dash), an empty line, one line per invoice line as "{date}  {formatMoney}" (two spaces), an empty line, "Total: {formatMoney}" followed by a space and the code only when the currency is one of the five known codes and is not USD (an unknown code is already written before the amount, so it is not repeated: "Total: CHF 140.00"), then "— {coachName}" when there is one; lines are joined with "\n". Dates are calendar dates with no time zone, written as short month and day in input.locale ("Aug 4" in en-US). These cases are ordinary private lessons: the apps add a note after the amount on a group lesson's line and on a billed cancellation's (decision #68), which the web's text does not have and no case here covers.
